answer: Each identity's history is laid down like shale - thin layers, one per job, pressed over time. Each layer is a quartz crystal, split by a prism into facets of work, attestations, connections. An honest crystal shows every color; farm crystals all share the same lattice and angles. The network also reads the pigment each identity's work leaves: honest shades are all different, but a farm's sockpuppets share one cheap pigment from a single pot. To pass, a farm must lay a different shale bed, a distinct crystal, and a unique pigment for every sockpuppet - as expensive as honest work.
